what.text: This page follows Venezuelans in Peru whom UNHCR counts as other people in need of international protection, a group separate from refugees.
At the end of 2025 there were 1098014 people in this group, 18.2% of all Venezuelans in it worldwide.
Only 4963 Venezuelans in Peru were counted as refugees that year.

why.text: The sources here don't say why people left Venezuela.
UNHCR's figures describe the scale of the movement, not its causes.

when.text: UNHCR's figures for this group in Peru start in 2018 at 428214 and peak at 1135215 in 2024.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025, after a big change between 2020 and 2021.

how.text: These are year-end totals reported to UNHCR, and UNHCR adds notes to some of the figures.
The figures have no breakdown by gender or age.
The sources don't say how people travelled or where in Peru they live.
